lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm2Mn12Bi2 (SmMn6Bi) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Bi and Sm centers each have 12 Mn neighbors, while Mn centers have 12 neighbors comprising 4 Bi, 6 Mn, and 2 Sm, with distances from 2.86 to 3.48 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mn–Mn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Bi–Mn and Mn–Sm pairs share edges.
